title: Get Access
subtitle: Pay the access fee to unlock all student resources, past exams, notes, assignments and more.
steps: Transfer 150 ETB to one of the accounts above.
Take a screenshot of the payment confirmation.
Message your payment screenshot and name to @gibigubae_admin on Telegram.
Your account will be activated once verified — usually within a few hours.
note: Valid for 12 months from approval • Full Access
